deployments_detail.use: "Chip" GenAI assistant (Azure/OpenAI) giving tradespeople technical advice via natural-language queries in the Howdens app

"Chip", a generative-AI digital assistant in the Howdens Trade App that gives trade customers step-by-step installation guides, product specs and fitting support via natural-language chat, 24/7. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Services]

Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption across employee productivity / back-office functions; Howdens was one of ~600 firms with early access and engaged PPT Group to manage its broader AI strategy and Copilot execution/integration. [Microsoft 365 Copilot; PPT Group (integration partner)]

Machine-learning production optimisation on SAP Business Technology Platform: predictive stoppage analysis (identifying BoM components / TPM causes of unplanned line outages) and changeover/sequencing optimisation on kitchen assembly lines. [NTT DATA Business Solutions, SAP Business Technology Platform]

Machine-learning customer-behaviour models: loyalty prediction from first-four-weeks purchase behaviour, customer segmentation/clustering, and sales-order cancellation prediction before invoicing (proof-of-concept work; not among the two prioritised for production). [NTT DATA Business Solutions, SAP Business Technology Platform]

Generative-AI kitchen-design feasibility study with Microsoft, exploring GenAI to generate initial kitchen design proposals that designers then refine, streamlining the design process. [Microsoft (Azure / generative AI)]

Planned integration of AI into SAP Digital Manufacturing production processes (announced as the next step after digital-manufacturing rollout that cut lead time from 21 to 14 days and reached 99.98% service level). [SAP Digital Manufacturing]

Creatio AI-native no-code platform consolidating five legacy systems into a single CRM for depot teams across the UK, France and Ireland, automating sales/CRM workflows (the depot account-management tool referenced in results). [Creatio]
deployments_detail.value: First depot live in 12 weeks (sixfold faster); sales strike rate up from 32% to 38%; 1,200+ qualified leads in six months
